messages:
Marta (PM): Quick prototype uploaded: compact first-run strip + resumable checklist modal. Need fast UX + a11y look. https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/onboard-mini
Eli (Design): Prefer modal for first-run; strip ok post-signup. Copy: 'Launch a demo' instead of 'Try a sample'.
June (Frontend): Note: strip should be role="region" aria-label="Onboarding strip"; respect prefers-reduced-motion and add focus-visible on cards.
Omar (A11y): Contrast: CTA border too light. Make it filled or darker. Carousel needs arrow-key nav and aria-roledescription="carousel". Announce progress changes with aria-live="polite".
Marta (PM): We'll A/B test modal-first vs strip-first. Track events: onboarding.opened, onboarding.sample_launched, onboarding.dismissed.
deploy-bot: Staging preview: https://staging.redwood.internal/onboard?exp=mini_strip_v3 :white_check_mark:
June (Frontend): I'll add keyboard tests and an undo toast on dismiss. Will ensure focus moves before removal.
Omar (A11y): I'll do a quick SR walkthrough once PR is up. Checklist for PR: contrast, focus trap, live updates, keyboard order.
Eli (Design): I'll push a small color tweak and compress card spacing for mobile by EOD.
Marta (PM): Great, thanks. Scheduling a 15-min playtest Thurs 10am.
